title: Stream Smarter: OBS-web Puts Your OBS Studio Control in Any Browser!
contentMarkdown:
## 📝 Quick Summary: 
OBS-web is a browser-based application that allows users to remotely control OBS Studio, offering features like scene switching, stream/recording control, and live preview. It requires OBS version 28+ and the obs-websocket plugin, and can be accessed locally or over the internet via WSS tunnels.

## 🔑 Key Takeaways

- ✅ Control OBS Studio remotely from any modern web browser (desktop or mobile).

- ✅ No installation needed; connects directly via OBS's built-in WebSocket server.

- ✅ Manage scenes, streaming, recording, Studio Mode, Virtual Camera, and more with ease.

- ✅ Significantly improves streaming/recording workflow by offering flexible, off-screen control.

- ✅ Supports both local network and internet control through WSS tunnels for ultimate flexibility.


## 📊 Project Statistics
- ⭐ Stars: 1462
- 🍴 Forks: 176
- ❗ Open Issues: 16


## 🛠 Tech Stack
- ✅ Svelte


Ever found yourself mid-stream, wishing you could switch scenes or start a recording without tabbing out of your game or presentation? Or maybe you're managing a co-host's stream and need a quick, discreet way to help them out? Well, fellow creators and tech enthusiasts, get ready to have your workflow revolutionized! I just stumbled upon an absolute gem on GitHub called `OBS-web`, and it's a game-changer for anyone using OBS Studio.The core problem `OBS-web` brilliantly solves is the need for flexible, remote control of your OBS instance. Historically, managing OBS meant being directly at your desktop, often tabbing out of your primary application. This project completely eliminates that friction, putting powerful control right at your fingertips, literally from any device with a modern web browser.So, what exactly is `OBS-web`? Imagine a sleek, intuitive dashboard that runs in your web browser – be it on your main monitor, a secondary screen, a tablet, or even your smartphone. This isn't some clunky app you need to install; it's a pure web application that connects directly to your OBS Studio using its built-in WebSocket server (which comes standard with OBS v28+). The beauty of this approach is its simplicity: no extra software, no complex configurations. You just open a URL, connect, and you're immediately in command.Functionality-wise, `OBS-web` is packed. You can effortlessly switch between scenes, toggle streaming or recording on and off, and manage your replay buffer with a single tap. For those who leverage OBS's advanced features, it fully supports Studio Mode, allowing you to preview your next scene before it goes live, ensuring smooth transitions. You can even control your Virtual Camera and switch between different OBS Profiles and Scene Collections. A really cool feature is the live, albeit low-framerate, view of your preview and program outputs, which is incredibly handy for monitoring your stream or recording from a distance. Plus, it includes smart additions like hiding scenes with `(hidden)` in their name and visually switching sources marked with `(switch)`, keeping your interface clean and efficient.The benefits for developers and content creators are immense. This tool dramatically enhances your workflow by freeing up your main screen. Streamers can keep their game or chat window front and center while managing OBS from a tablet beside them. For collaborative projects or remote assistance, the support for WSS tunnels means you can even control OBS from outside your local network, offering unparalleled flexibility and peace of mind. As an open-source project, it also invites developers to dive into the code, customize it to their specific needs, or contribute new features, making it a truly community-driven solution. If you're looking to streamline your OBS experience and gain more control, `OBS-web` is an absolute must-check-out. It’s simple, powerful, and incredibly practical.
